messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Sales Leadership <sales-leads@redwood.com>, AEs <account-execs@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast clean-room: commit & best-case definitions + quick training

Team —

Quick note ahead of EOD: our finance partners flagged an uptick in classification drift across Commit / Best Case this cycle. To avoid noisy edits during the close, I want a short "clean-room" alignment session that accomplishes two things:

1) Reconfirm the operational definitions for Commit vs Best Case (2 slides).
2) Walk through three anonymized examples from the West region and show the expected reclassification.

Logistics: 30 minutes, recorded, light prework (see attached mapping spreadsheet). Please come prepared with 2 deals from your book that are on the fence (stage >= Proposal) so we can use them as examples.

Proposed times: 11:00 - 11:30 PT or 14:00 - 14:30 PT today. Reply with which slot works (or suggest urgent conflicts).

Attachments: 2027_forecast_mapping.xlsx (definition -> examples), commit_examples.pdf (doctored examples).

Why this matters: last cycle we had ~6% over-commit due to inconsistent Best Case labeling; a fast realignment reduces churn for finance and makes our bookings plan more defensible in leadership reviews.

Thanks — Rafael
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference

Rafael —

11:00 PT works for me. Quick clarifying Qs before we go live:
- On "Commit" do we want reps to require verbal customer commitment + signed PO in hand, or is a firm legal contract sufficient? Our AE playbook has a slightly different line that some reps still use.
- For "Best Case" is it specifically "expected close this quarter if no material blockers remain" (i.e., internal confidence metric) or is it tied to a target close date?

I'll bring two examples from today (one reseller-backed deal and one direct).

Thanks — Karthik

Thanks all — good sync. Notes & actions below (recording + attachments posted to Drive):

Summary: Agreed operating definitions —
- Commit = signed PO or executed contract + confirmed delivery window; verbal or "soft" agreements without signature belong in Best Case.
- Best Case = likely close this quarter if current blockers are resolved; should include an expected close date and a note on remaining blockers.

Actions (owners + deadlines):
- Marissa: post sanitized examples and 2-slide definitions in Drive (done) — file names: commit_examples.pdf, 2027_forecast_mapping.xlsx.
- Laura: upload recording and 3-minute highlight clip to /Forecast Ops/Recordings by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik & AEs: review your top-10 deals and flag any reclassifications in HubSpot (HS-12345) by COB Friday.
- Rafael: work with finance to freeze retrospective edits after close window start (TBD) and circulate policy.

Notes: Finance accepted the first-pass reclassifications for deals with evidence attached. We all agreed to a conservative bias for Commit — if in doubt, mark Best Case and add the note.

If you couldn't make the live session, watch the 3-minute clip and complete the quick quiz in the Drive folder (2 questions).

— Rafael
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
